verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing states that recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized. Its MCP docs describe call transcripts as data you manage alongside conversations, and voicemail transcripts can be retrieved with call history. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that summaries and transcripts are attached inside the conversation thread itself, in-depth feature docs beyond the marketing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
